method: For each of the 109 Lean terminal forms, enumerate consumption_domain(B58,M51), retain 2*B7<M51 and popcount(B7)=7, and check exact carry-free local shifts. Independently brute_pairs checks every retained option set.
claim_boundary: Complete local computational compatibility only. Earlier graph production/reuse and cost remain to be imposed. No whole-graph solution or Lean reduction theorem is claimed.
